title: koeleria glauca
intro: Koeleria glauca, commonly known as blue hair grass, is a perennial grass species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria glauca are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
